cohort: Women who gave birth in comprehensive emergency obstetric care centers in Bhutan in 2018
finding: The cesarean section rate in Bhutan was 18.7%, with common indications being previous CS, fetal distress, prolonged labor, and failed induction, and associated factors included maternal age over 25 years, male child, fewer living children, multiple pregnancy, gestation over 40 weeks, and delivery at specific hospitals.
